The dark AlphaESS dashboard is now the integration's default dashboard design, with live HA readings, an eight-hour solar graph, signed power-flow animation, compact control rows and grouped diagnostics.

- Power Flow above Energy Today and Battery Health; no diagnostics column on Overview.
- Larger text, native HA navigation only, and panels that stack on phones.
- Grid import/export and battery charge/discharge animations follow actual signed power. Zero/unavailable readings stop animation.
- Battery status numeric suffixes removed from display only.
- PV1 and PV2 always visible. PV3/PV4 hide while zero, missing or unavailable, and return when producing power.
- Registry-based discovery supports renamed entities and separate inverters. Controls open the existing HA details dialogs; the frontend makes no inverter service calls.
- Updated README, HACS details and desktop/mobile screenshots of the actual frontend with example data.

## Install and open

Select **v1.19.3b4** with beta versions enabled in HACS. Restart Home Assistant, then fully refresh the browser/Companion App frontend. Open **AlphaESS (Beta)**.

The integration packages and registers the frontend. It creates the sidebar dashboard if absent, or migrates this fork's recognised three-view Beta dashboard after saving its previous config. Existing managed AlphaESS strategy dashboards use the new design. Unrelated/modified dashboards, YAML dashboards, and your personal HA landing page are preserved. No separate custom-card download or YAML copy/paste is required for the default storage-mode setup.

## Scope and testing

No Modbus register, polling, sensor identity, charging, discharging, export, Hold/Freeze, Hold for Car, EV charging, Demand/ECO or PredBat control implementation changes. Existing loader diagnostics are retained; this is not a claimed fix for the intermittent iOS loading timeout.

Local verification: 20 frontend tests; 140 Python tests on HA 2024.12.5/Python 3.12 and HA 2026.10.0/Python 3.14. Desktop and phone browser QA uses example data; no inverter commands were exercised. Release automation repeats both Python suites and frontend tests before publication.

Rollback: select **v1.19.3b3**, restart and refresh. The saved AlphaESS strategy works with that version and restores its previous managed layout. See the dashboard guide for custom dashboard and native-example details. **v1.19.2 remains the stable release.**
